description:
🛒 E-Commerce Sales Analytics Dashboard
Project Overview

Developed an interactive E-Commerce Sales Analytics Dashboard to analyze sales performance, profitability, customer segments, products, payment methods, and geographic sales across multiple regions and countries from January 2023 to December 2025.

The dashboard helps identify top-performing products, high-revenue regions, customer segment contribution, monthly sales trends, and payment-method usage.

🛠️ Tools & Technologies
Power BI
Power Query – Data cleaning and transformation
DAX – Measures and KPIs
Data Visualization
Data Analysis
Interactive Filters / Slicers
📊 Key KPIs

The dashboard tracks:

KPI	Value
Total Sales	484.56K
Total Profit	158.87K
Average Order Value	242.28
Total Quantity	7K
Total Orders	2K

These KPIs dynamically change based on the selected filters.

This allows product/category performance to be analyzed quickly.

📈 Important Business Insights

From the dashboard:

1. Furniture is a major sales contributor

Furniture generates approximately 256.27K in the displayed category analysis, making it a substantial contributor to overall sales.

2. Standing Desk Converter leads individual products

The Standing Desk Converter appears as the highest-selling product in the Top 10 visualization.

3. Regional performance varies

The dashboard shows differences in sales contribution between Europe, North America, Asia Pacific, South America, and Middle East & Africa.

4. Consumer segment contributes the largest share

The Customer Segment Split visualization shows Consumer contributing more sales than Corporate and Home Office.

5. Sales fluctuate throughout the year

The monthly trend shows noticeable changes in both sales and profit, allowing management to identify stronger and weaker periods.

6. Payment behavior can be analyzed

Payment Method Usage provides a comparison of how customers use Bank Transfer, Cash on Delivery, Credit Card, and PayPal.

🎯 Project Objectives

You can describe the objectives as:

Analyze overall e-commerce sales and profitability.
Track important business KPIs.
Identify top-performing products and categories.
Compare sales performance across regions and countries.
Understand customer segment contribution.
Analyze payment-method usage.
Monitor monthly sales and profit trends.
Provide interactive filtering for business users.
Create a dashboard that supports data-driven business decisions.
